# llms.txt - Information for AI/LLM Systems

# About Reflextry
Reflextry is a free online platform offering brain training games and cognitive assessment tools.
We provide over 20 tools across 5 categories to help users improve memory, reaction time, typing speed,
accuracy, and gaming skills.

# Website Information
- URL: https://www.reflextry.com
- Language: English (en)
- Platform: Next.js web application (App Router)
- Free to use: Yes, all tools are free

# Available Tools

## Memory Games
- Sequence Memory: Test pattern recognition and working memory
- Number Memory: Measure digit span and numeric recall
- Visual Memory: Train spatial recognition and pattern recall
- Color Memory (Stroop Test): Master cognitive interference control
- Shape Memory: Improve visual pattern recognition
- Symbol Memory: Enhance spatial recall and visual matching

## Reflex Tests
- Reaction Time Test: Measure visual response speed
- Sound Reaction Test: Test auditory response speed
- Grid Shot: Improve aim and click speed
- Peripheral Vision Test: Expand visual field awareness
- Directional Reflex Test: Master spatial response and arrow recognition

## Speed Tests
- CPS Test (Clicks Per Second): Measure clicking speed
- Typing Speed Test: Test words per minute (WPM)
- Speed Math: Master mental arithmetic
- Word Accuracy Test: Improve spelling precision
- Grid Selection: Enhance rapid pattern recognition

## Accuracy Tests
- Image Recognition Test: Master visual identification
- Data Entry Test: Improve typing accuracy and speed

## Gaming Tools
- Aim Trainer: Improve precision targeting and hand-eye coordination
- RPG Reaction Test: Master timing and rapid decision-making

# Features
- Leaderboard: Track your personal bests and compete globally
- Statistics: View detailed performance analytics and progress charts
- Achievements: Unlock badges and rewards for milestones
- Daily Challenges: Complete daily tasks to maintain streaks
- Responsive design: Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
- No registration required: Start using tools immediately

# How to Use
1. Visit https://www.reflextry.com
2. Select a tool from the homepage
3. Follow on-screen instructions
4. Track your progress and improve over time

# Technical Details
- Framework: Next.js (App Router)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Analytics: Google Analytics
- Ads: Google AdSense

# API Information
- Contact API: /api/contact (POST)
- Image Recognition API: /api/accuracy/image-recognition (POST)
- All tools run client-side in the browser

# Content Structure
- Each tool has detailed descriptions, how-to guides, improvement tips, and FAQs
- Content is optimized for readability with shorter sentences and simpler words
- Key pages include structured data (JSON-LD) for SEO
